name: Solvent-based purification of plastics
principle: Polymer waste is dissolved in a solvent, filtered or extracted to remove colour, odour and additives, and the polymer is recovered as near-virgin resin. PureCycle's Ironton, Ohio plant uses a process licensed from Procter & Gamble for polypropylene and made first pellets in June 2023; planned capacity is 107 million pounds a year of recycled resin.

source.note: Renewable Carbon News, PureCycle's Ironton plant produces first pellets, June 2023
